<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" id="Definitions_OnlineShopOrdering" targetNamespace="http://example.org/bpmn/online-shop-ordering">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_PaymentConfirmation" name="Payment confirmation"/>
  <bpmn:process id="Process_OnlineShopOrdering" name="Ordering in an Online Shop" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_OnlineShop">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Customer" name="Customer">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>StartEvent_1</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_Login</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_ProductsMerge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SelectProduct</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_AddToCart</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SaveProduct</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_LoginFailed</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_EnterPayment</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_EnterShipping</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_BillingSplit</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_EnterBilling</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_BillingJoin</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_EShopSystem" name="E-Shop System">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_CheckCredentials</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_LoginCheck</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_CheckAllSelected</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_AllSelected</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_FinishOrder</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_PrepSplit</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Catch_PaymentConfirm</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_PrepJoin</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_CompleteOrder</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_OrderCompleted</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_1" name="Customer starts shopping"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_Login" name="Log in"/>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_CheckCredentials" name="Check credentials"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_LoginCheck" name="Login successful?"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_LoginFailed" name="Shopping stopped"/>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ProductsMerge" name="Merge before product selection"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SelectProduct" name="Select product"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_AddToCart" name="Add product to shopping cart"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SaveProduct" name="Save product"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckAllSelected" name="Check whether all products are selected"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_AllSelected" name="All products selected?"/>

    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_FinishOrder" name="Finish order"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_PrepSplit" name="Prepare payment and shipment"/>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_EnterPayment" name="Enter payment data"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Catch_PaymentConfirm" name="Payment confirmed by bank">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_PaymentConfirmation" messageRef="Message_PaymentConfirmation"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_EnterShipping" name="Enter shipping address"/>
    <bpmn:inclusiveGateway id="Gateway_BillingSplit" name="Shipping address differs from billing address?" default="Flow_BillingSame"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_EnterBilling" name="Enter billing address"/>
    <bpmn:inclusiveGateway id="Gateway_BillingJoin" name="Address entry done"/>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_PrepJoin" name="Payment and address done"/>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_CompleteOrder" name="Complete order"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_OrderCompleted" name="Order completed"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StartToLogin" sourceRef="StartEvent_1" targetRef="Task_Login"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_LoginToCheck" sourceRef="Task_Login" targetRef="Task_CheckCredentials"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CheckToLoginGw" sourceRef="Task_CheckCredentials" targetRef="Gateway_LoginCheck"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_LoginOk" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_LoginCheck" targetRef="Gateway_ProductsMerge">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${loginSuccessful}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_LoginFailed" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_LoginCheck" targetRef="EndEvent_LoginFailed">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${!loginSuccessful}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MergeToSelect" sourceRef="Gateway_ProductsMerge" targetRef="Task_SelectProduct"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SelectToAdd" sourceRef="Task_SelectProduct" targetRef="Task_AddToCart"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AddToSave" sourceRef="Task_AddToCart" targetRef="Task_SaveProduct"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SaveToCheckAll" sourceRef="Task_SaveProduct" targetRef="Task_CheckAllSelected"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CheckAllToGw" sourceRef="Task_CheckAllSelected" targetRef="Gateway_AllSelected"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotAllSelected" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_AllSelected" targetRef="Gateway_ProductsMerge">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${!allProductsSelected}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AllSelected" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_AllSelected" targetRef="Task_FinishOrder">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${allProductsSelected}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FinishToPrepSplit" sourceRef="Task_FinishOrder" targetRef="Gateway_PrepSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SplitToPayment" sourceRef="Gateway_PrepSplit" targetRef="Task_EnterPayment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SplitToShipping" sourceRef="Gateway_PrepSplit" targetRef="Task_EnterShipping"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PaymentToConfirm" sourceRef="Task_EnterPayment" targetRef="Catch_PaymentConfirm"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ConfirmToPrepJoin" sourceRef="Catch_PaymentConfirm" targetRef="Gateway_PrepJoin"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ShippingToBillingSplit" sourceRef="Task_EnterShipping" targetRef="Gateway_BillingSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_BillingDiffers" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_BillingSplit" targetRef="Task_EnterBilling">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${addressDiffers}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_BillingSame" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_BillingSplit" targetRef="Gateway_BillingJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_BillingToJoin" sourceRef="Task_EnterBilling" targetRef="Gateway_BillingJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_BillingJoinToPrepJoin" sourceRef="Gateway_BillingJoin" targetRef="Gateway_PrepJoin"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PrepJoinToComplete" sourceRef="Gateway_PrepJoin" targetRef="Task_CompleteOrder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CompleteToEnd" sourceRef="Task_CompleteOrder" targetRef="EndEvent_OrderCompleted"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
